engine: PostgreSQL 16 Alpine in a local Docker fixture
case: Structured filter operator matrix for custom enum and domain-over-enum columns
added_coverage: Both ordinary enum and domain-over-enum filters now cover every shared FilterOp: equality and inequality; <, <=, >, >=; Contains, StartsWith, EndsWith, Like, NotLike and ILike; IsNull and IsNotNull; In, NotIn and Between.
Each comparison/pattern/list case asserts exact ordered row identities and labels; enum cases also check the native enum type, and domain cases check pg_typeof(domain_column)::text.
The fixtures include literal label NULL, SQL NULL, a Unicode enum label, and enum ordering. Pattern filters exercise the builder's enum-to-text path.
independent_oracle: PostgreSQL 16 query results with exact row IDs/labels and native enum/domain type text.

ordinary_enum_focused.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration value_contract_custom_enum_filters_preserve_labels_and_sql_null -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1

domain_enum_focused.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration value_contract_domain_over_enum_filters_preserve_values_and_type -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1

enum_contract_suite.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration enum_contract:: -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1

domain_contract_suite.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration domain_contract:: -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

validation.format_and_diff_checks: cargo fmt --all -- --check and git diff --check passed

remaining: Other direct query-parameter operator contexts, session/search_path combinations, deeper domain chains and other native types remain open.
This filter matrix does not close B3 or qualify the 0.2.0 release.
